## Où j'en suis
The team moved HubSpot owner/ARR sync from webhooks to polling: #405 was closed (private app tokens can't manage webhook subscriptions) and the polling job was built on `daniel/hubspot-owner-sync` — CRM search every 15 min, windowed paging past the 10k cap, only companies with ARR > 0 (trials skipped). PR #409 is open with auto-merge (squash) enabled, but the required e2e check fails because its fixture contains a trial company the filter now skips.

- [en-cours] Fix e2e `test_admin_accounts.py::test_accounts_table_shows_owner`: expected 3 rows with owner, got 2 (source: t18)
- [prochaine-étape] Update the e2e fixture (ARR > 0 on third company, or expect 2 rows), let auto-merge fire on #409
- [prochaine-étape] Noa to add `HUBSPOT_TOKEN` to AWS Secrets Manager for staging/prod (source: t12)
- [essai-raté] Webhook subscription API call failed with 401: requires a developer API key, private app token unsupported → switched to polling (t03)
- [décision] Use polling every 15 min instead of webhooks; close #405 (source: t04)
- [décision] Sync only companies with ARR > 0, skip trials entirely (source: t10)
